children: RNS Number : 8940T  Chelverton UK Dividend Trust PLC  08 September 2026
The Company has today declared a first interim dividend in respect of the year 1 May 2026 to 30 April 2027 of 2.5p per share (2025: 2.5p).
This dividend will be paid on 9 October 2026 to the holders of Ordinary shares on the register as at 25 September 2026, with an ex-dividend date of 24 September 2026.
It is the Board's intention that this payment will be the first of four equal core dividend payments of 2.5p each, being a total of 10.00p, for the year ending 30 April 2027.
